    ]]>

</catalog>

<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record)*>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base-ent "Base Record Data">
  <!ENTITY comp-ent "&base-ent; with Composite Extension">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY raw-file SYSTEM "data.txt" NDATA txt>
  <!ENTITY % p-decl "<!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>">
  %p-decl;
]>
<?xml-timestamp value="2023-10-27T10:00:00Z"?>
<archive xmlns="urn:archive:schema" xmlns:meta="urn:archive:meta">
  <!-- Container for archived entries -->
  <meta:metadata>
    <?meta-action type="validate" level="strict"?>
  </meta:metadata>
  <record meta:status="active">
    <![CDATA[
      Unprocessed CDATA block with entity-like strings: &comp-ent;
    ]]>
  </record>
  <record>&comp-ent;</record>
</archive>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY alpha "Alpha Entity">
  <!ENTITY beta "α -> Beta Entity">
  <!ENTITY gamma "β -> Gamma Entity">
  <!ENTITY % entity-macro "<!ENTITY delta 'Delta Parameter Value'>">
  %entity-macro;
]>
<?xml-debug level="verbose" target="parser"?>
<document xmlns="http://doc.org/ns" xmlns:ns1="http://doc.org/ns1" xmlns:ns2="http://doc.org/ns2">
  <!-- Top level comment detailing namespace usage -->
  <ns1:section ns2:role="primary">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section covering complex entities: γ and δ
    ]]>
  </ns1:section>
  <section>γ</section>
</document>

<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item)*>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY default-val "Default Inventory Item">
  <!ENTITY batch-val "&default-val; [Batch #100]">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY manual SYSTEM "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <!ENTITY % remote-macro "<!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>">
  %remote-macro;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="inventory.css"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org/schema" xmlns:x="http://inventory.org/ext">
  <!-- Inventory header comment -->
  <x:log>
    <?x:audit user="admin" action="scan"?>
  </x:log>
  <item>
    <![CDATA[
      Special CDATA string containing unparsed entities: &batch-val;
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item>&batch-val;</item>
</inventory>
